description: This file contains utility functions related to audit context and signature block creation for a frontend dashboard, including generating timestamps, selecting user roles, and building audit/signature objects.

methods.name: nowUtcIso()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp in ISO string format.

methods.name: pickActorRole(profile)
methods.description: Determines the acting user's role for audit purposes based on profile roles, prioritizing explicit governance/admin roles.

methods.name: buildAuditContext(profile)
methods.description: Creates an audit context object with user ID, role, timestamp, and request ID.

methods.name: pickSignerRole(profile)
methods.description: Determines the signer role for a signature block, prioritizing governance or steward roles, with a fallback to quality_owner.

methods.name: buildSignatureBlock(profile, signatureReason)
methods.description: Constructs a signature block object with signer details, timestamp, and signature reason.
